messages.text:
Hello,

I just got the PSU. But the XT30 that came with this is too small.

Kindly advise me what to do with this.

Thanks,
Dhana
Handed to the team · Sending a replacement cable/adapter is not something I can do with my tools.

Hi Dhana,

Thanks for letting me know, and sorry about that. Don't force it or cut anything off the PSU. The connector sizes in this family look alike but they are not interchangeable: XT30 is the small one, XT60 is the larger one, and if the socket on your board is the bigger one then the lead that shipped with the PSU is simply the wrong size. The fix is a short XT30 female to XT60 male adapter lead, or a replacement pigtail, not a different power supply. The A. unit itself is the right one for your miner.

So I can send the exact matching part rather than guess, could you reply with one photo of the power socket on the miner board with the new PSU lead held next to it? That shows me both ends in one shot.

I have put this in front of a colleague with your order and the details. The team is offline right now and picks it up tomorrow at 10am Eastern, and they will come back to you in this thread with the lead on its way. Nothing needs to go back to us.

If you want a second pair of eyes faster, our Discord is open around the clock at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, and JD, our hardware guy, is there as @nullhashrate.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
